title: ScenarioPackHandlers
description: The handlers sections of the Scenario pack contents (INV-REQ-416, INV-REQ-417, INV-REQ-1805, INV-REQ-2433, INV-REQ-2444, INV-REQ-2447, INV-REQ-2443): the artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly scenario. The sibling file scenario-pack-rendition-wording.schema.json describes the rendition wording section: the contents object of a Scenario pack is valid against both files, and each file ignores the properties of the other. Each entry carries a sourceClass and a sourceReference (INV-REQ-727). Rules a JSON Schema cannot express are checked by rules-svc at the pack dry run and by the seed content test, not here: (tag, side) is unique in schemeTagSides; the key (tag, side, the set counterpartyApprovedUnder, writtenAgreement) is unique in treatments; every treatment names a (tag, side) that schemeTagSides lists as HANDLED; every scheme in counterpartyApprovedUnder is in approvableSchemes; a tag that no row of schemeTagSides lists is refused at mapping authoring (fail closed); a HANDLED (tag, side) with no treatment follows the general rules; an entry whose sourceClass is INFERRED blocks the mapping sign-off that depends on it with RUL-007 (INV-REQ-728); a line whose counterparty has no matching status gets RUL-011 and a line under a PENDING_QUESTION row gets RUL-004, both engine codes. A consumer ignores any property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. Within a major version this schema is additive-only.

selfBillingAssignment.description: The self-billing party-to-type assignment (INV-REQ-416), two named objects so that both parties are present by construction.

schemeTagSides.description: Per scheme tag, the sides it may be used on and whether the pair is handled (INV-REQ-2444).

treatments.description: The treatments the scheme handlers decide (INV-REQ-1805, INV-REQ-2447).

approvableSchemes.description: The schemes a counterparty approved status may name (INV-REQ-2433).

supplyDateBasis.description: Optional adopted readings of the date of transaction (INV-REQ-2443).

sourceClass.description: The source class of the entry (INV-REQ-727). An INFERRED entry blocks the mapping sign-off that depends on it with RUL-007 (INV-REQ-728); the check is rules-svc's.

sourceReference.description: The citation of the entry: the source that supports it.

tag.description: A scheme tag or scheme name. A string and not an enum, because a scheme IRAS adds is a pack release (INV-REQ-2433).

side.description: The side of a transaction the entry applies to.

party.description: The assignment for one self-billing party (INV-REQ-416): the direction recorded and the submission type.

direction.description: The direction recorded for the party.

submissionType.description: The submission type decided for the party.

schemeTagSide.description: One side a scheme tag may be used on, handled or pending an open question (INV-REQ-2444).

handling.description: HANDLED: a handler treats the pair. PENDING_QUESTION: the flow is blocked with RUL-004 pending an open question.

pendingReference.description: The open question the pair waits for. Present exactly when handling is PENDING_QUESTION.

treatment.description: The treatment a handler decides for a (tag, side) pair (INV-REQ-1805): category code, rate and IBT-022 statement.

categoryCode.description: The category code returned; the pattern of the Code catalogue code.

rateBasis.description: FIXED: the rate is the property rate. PREVAILING: the prevailing rate applies and rate is absent.

counterpartyApprovedUnder.description: The schemes of which the counterparty must hold an approved status for this treatment to apply.

writtenAgreement.description: Whether a written agreement is recorded for the counterparty.

rate.description: The rate as a decimal string. Present exactly when rateBasis is FIXED.

ibt022Statement.description: The statement written into IBT-022; the bound of EvaluationResult.ibt022Statement.

approvableScheme.description: A scheme a counterparty status may name (INV-REQ-2433).

supplyDateBasisRow.description: The adopted reading of the date of transaction for a scheme (INV-REQ-2443).

dateBasis.description: The date the date of transaction follows.
